# Working of Shell Sort

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Working of Shell Sort

2.1. Reduce the gap.

Let our new interval be half of the previous one, i.e., 2.

2.2. Compare and sort based on the interval.

We have the following semi-sorted vector:

![Partially Sorted Vector](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, we'll create a subvector of elements at an interval of 2 starting from the 0th index.

![Create a Subvector of Elements at Interval 2](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, let's sort this subvector using insertion sort. Then, we insert the elements of this sorted subvector back into the original vector in the corresponding order.

![Sort the Subvector and Insert in Corresponding Order](data:image/png;base64,)

2.3. Repeat for the rest of the elements.

Now, we'll create a subvector of elements at an interval of 2 starting from the 1st index.

![Create a Subvector of Remaining Elements at Interval 2](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, let's sort this subvector using insertion sort and insert the elements in the vector in sorted order.

![Sort the Subvector and Insert In Corresponding Order](data:image/png;base64,)

The loop with interval 2 is complete.

Finally, we will reduce the interval to 1 and repeat the same process to get the final sorted vector.
